title: One read-state transition
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean input, $s$ an emitter state, $i\le |w|$, and $out$ an output list. Starting the emitter machine in the read state with phase $s.\varphi$, input-head position corresponding to $i$, unary work tapes encoding the coordinates of $s$, and output $out$, its configuration after one step is exactly the result of applying the action prescribed by the transition rule for that read state, the input symbol at position $i$ (if present), and the symbols under those work-tape heads.
